# three.js 0.186.1 (MIT)

Vendored ES modules — no CDN needed. Imported via import map in
`office_3d.html` and `index.html` (`three`, `three/addons/`).

- `build/three.module.js` + `build/three.core.js` (r186 split build)
- `examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js`
- `examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js`
- `examples/jsm/environments/RoomEnvironment.js`
- `examples/jsm/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js`
- `examples/jsm/utils/SkeletonUtils.js`
- `LICENSE` (MIT, (c) three.js authors)

Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.186.1/
Upgrading: re-download the same paths at the new version and keep
all files on that exact version.
